summary.intent: Complete Phase 19.2 IPFS upload performance optimization — execute gap closure plans, deploy pebbleds datastore to staging, run matched load tests, and merge the release.
summary.outcome: Phase 19.2 fully executed and merged (PR #342). Staging deployed with pebbleds + concurrent pin orchestration. Post-19.2 staging load tests showed 157% throughput improvement (5.87→15.10 ops/s at 5x client count) and survival at 200 concurrent users where the system previously broke entirely.

repo: Concurrent SDK pins (Promise.allSettled) alone cause a p95 regression at 50 clients — p95 jumped 18.7s→44.7s on flatfs. pebbleds is required to absorb the doubled write load; the two optimizations are synergistic.

Load test secrets (LOAD_TEST_SECRET, THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET) must be passed as inline shell env vars — vitest does not use dotenv. Pattern: `LOAD_TEST_SECRET=x THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET=y pnpm exec vitest run ...`
THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET is sent as X-Throttle-Bypass header; API's BypassableThrottlerGuard skips rate limiting when it matches and NODE_ENV !== 'production'.
Valid CIDs on staging are tracked in two places: pinned_cids table (presence = active) and folder_ipns.latest_cid IS NOT NULL. Everything pinned on Kubo not in those tables is stale.
DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL should point to someguy at 192.168.133.114:8190 for realistic staging-comparable testing, not mock-ipns-routing (localhost:3001).
The tag-staging-release GitHub Actions workflow must be used to create staging release tags — do not push raw git tags manually.
ipfs-ds-convert is archived and incompatible with modern Kubo. In-place flatfs→pebbleds conversion is not possible. For future production migrations, DAG export/import (CAR files) is the viable path.

code.finding: Concurrent pin orchestration via Promise.allSettled — IPNS publish and folder metadata update run in parallel. Failure handling checks totalFailed only when batchResult.value exists (guard needed since mock returns undefined in tests).
Added ipns:batchPublishFailed typed event to match share:reWrapFailed pattern — batch publish failures now surface as SDK events, not just console.warn.
Shared test helpers (createTestConfig, setupFolder) extracted from 3 duplicate test files. Helper uses Object.freeze on config to prevent test aliasing mutations.
New test file covering concurrent pin orchestration. All mock batchPublishIpnsRecords calls must return { totalSucceeded, totalFailed } — returning undefined causes guard check to fail silently.

workflow: For staged load testing, CI is the right runner for staging comparisons (consistent hardware/network). Local dev results are useful for isolation but not directly comparable to pre-optimization staging baselines.

When probing concurrency limits, push until errors appear rather than stopping at the first sign of latency degradation — the 'knee' and 'breaking point' are different, and worst-case baseline data makes improvements more visible.
Bitswap pin-by-pin migration of ~31K CIDs is impractical (effectively stuck after minutes). For future datastore migrations with nearly-clean data, clean slate is the right call for staging.
Always verify the 1Password SSH agent socket is active before attempting remote operations that depend on it. The socket path is in ~/.ssh/config but the agent process must be running.
When killing duplicate API processes, confirm port ownership first — the latest PID holds the port, older pnpm wrapper processes may be zombies but still need force-killing.

friction: Bitswap pin-by-pin migration stalled immediately — after 30+ minutes only 1 CID pinned out of 31,254. VPS became unresponsive from the load. Had to abort and go clean slate.
ipfs-ds-convert was investigated as an in-place conversion path but is archived and incompatible with modern Kubo — dead end.
1Password SSH agent socket wasn't active, blocking SSH access until the user opened a terminal session directly.
Multiple API processes accumulated on port 3000 from repeated test runs — required manual force-kill of zombie pnpm wrappers.
Load test background task for 75/100 clients exited with code 255 (SSH dropped) rather than returning results cleanly.
Premature git tag push triggered before the tag-staging-release workflow was used — had to revert and retrigger properly.
Pre-optimization SDK checkout left the working directory inside tests/load, causing git restore to fail until run from repo root.
open_items: Load tests should handle 401s with token refresh — JWT tokens expire during long-running (600s+) load tests, causing auth failures at high client counts. Todo created: .planning/todos/pending/2026-03-23-load-tests-should-handle-401s-with-token-refresh.md
Investigate removal of mock-ipns-routing layer now that someguy is properly integrated into the stack. Todo: .planning/todos/pending/2026-03-23-investigate-removal-of-mock-ipns-routing-layer.md
Staging Prometheus baselines (pin mean latency -20.8%, histogram data) added to post-optimization baselines on a new branch — confirm that branch PR was merged.

batchResult totalFailed edge case: Copilot noted the case where batchPublishIpnsRecords returns a fulfilled result with partial failures (totalFailed > 0) — acknowledged as intentional with retry queue as follow-up work.

Production IPFS datastore migration strategy: documented in .learnings/ with DAG export/import as the recommended path, but the actual procedure has not been rehearsed and the migration script is staging-specific.

SC3 (>15% throughput improvement at 50+ concurrent users) was not met in local dev tests (+7%) but was definitively met on staging (+157%) — the VERIFICATION.md SC3 status may need updating to reflect the staging results.
